additions.name: fill-issuer-fetched
additions.covers: An issuer the CMS leaves out is fetched from the address the signer names, and the path is followed.

additions.name: fill-issuer-bundle
additions.covers: The issuer address serves a PKCS #7 bundle; and one that serves nothing readable.

additions.name: fill-names-no-address
additions.covers: A certificate that names no address to ask at, collected all or nothing.

additions.name: fill-crl-over-limit
additions.covers: An answer that says nothing, then a list over maxCrlBytes: both named, nothing stored.

additions.name: fill-source-throws
additions.covers: A source that throws something other than an EngineError: a Network error naming the address.

additions.name: splice-indefinite-and-ordered
additions.covers: Attaching to a CMS with indefinite lengths keeps them indefinite; attaching beside other unsigned attributes puts the token where DER orders it.

additions.name: route-max-reply-bytes
additions.covers: A revocation source with its reply limit set: an answer within it is passed on.

additions.name: tsa-status-text-not-utf8
additions.covers: A TimeStampResp whose status text is a PrintableString does not fit the schema.

additions.name: lt-timestamped-enabled
additions.covers: A signature with a trusted timestamp and a stored answer good at its time is long-term enabled.

additions.name: lt-timestamped-no-answer
additions.covers: A trusted timestamp with nothing stored: no answer for the signer at that time.

additions.name: lt-timestamp-untrusted
additions.covers: Without the authority's certificate among the anchors, the timestamp proves no time to you.

additions.name: lt-timestamp-not-its-own
additions.covers: A timestamp over other bytes is invalid; the signature stays valid.

additions.name: lt-tsa-purposes
additions.covers: An authority whose timestamping purpose is not critical, or not its only one, is not trusted to say the time.

additions.name: lt-document-timestamp
additions.covers: A document timestamp after the signature: it vouches for the signature at its time, and is judged now itself.

additions.name: lt-document-timestamp-other-bytes
additions.covers: A document timestamp over other bytes: integrity invalid, the token judged against what it stamps.

additions.name: lt-document-timestamp-unreadable
additions.covers: A document timestamp whose contents are no token.

additions.name: lt-collect-timestamped
additions.covers: addValidationInfo for a timestamped signature asks for the answer and stores it with the paths.

additions.name: lt-collect-stored
additions.covers: addValidationInfo when the file already holds the answer: nothing new to store.

additions.name: attach-timestamp
additions.covers: attachSignatureTimestamp: a token over the signature value, spliced in as an unsigned attribute; and what it refuses.

additions.name: complete-signature
additions.covers: completeSignature: the gate, the timestamp, the gate again, complete; and its refusals.

additions.name: gate-signature-timestamps
additions.covers: The gate refuses a CMS whose timestamp stamps other bytes, and checks a document timestamp's token.

additions.name: answers-ocsp
additions.covers: checkRevocationAnswer over OCSP responses: each branch, the well-formed ones and the malformed.

additions.name: answers-crl
additions.covers: checkRevocationAnswer over CRLs: each branch, the well-formed ones and the malformed.

additions.name: ltv-ocsp-good
additions.covers: A stored OCSP answer from the authority's responder says the signer was good.

additions.name: ltv-crl-shared-serial
additions.covers: Under the scripted WebCrypto every serial is 5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5a, so the CRL that withdraws one signer lists the other: a CRL entry matches by serial number alone.

additions.name: ltv-withdrawn
additions.covers: The CRL says the signer was withdrawn the day before: revoked, and the verdict is invalid.

additions.name: ltv-answers-about-others
additions.covers: Bytes that are no answer say nothing; the authority answers by serial, the same for every certificate here, so its OCSP answers speak for the signer.

additions.name: ltv-now-without-answers
additions.covers: Judged now with nothing stored: no answer speaks for now.

additions.name: ltv-asks-the-source
additions.covers: validateSignatures with a revocation source asks it for what the file lacks, and uses the answer.

additions.name: collect-needs-trust
additions.covers: addValidationInfo without trust is refused before anything is asked.

additions.name: collect-no-timestamp
additions.covers: All or nothing: a signature with no trusted timestamp is refused, and nothing is stored.

additions.name: collect-partial
additions.covers: partial: what there is is stored, and the verdicts say what is missing.

additions.name: collect-partial-unanswered
additions.covers: partial with a source that does not answer, and with known answers.

additions.name: collect-fields
additions.covers: fields picks the signatures to cover; a field with no signature is NotFound.

additions.name: tsa-granted
additions.covers: httpTimestampAuthority: the RFC 3161 query it sends (D-1), and a granted reply with the nonce echoed.

additions.name: tsa-policy-headers
additions.covers: A policy and headers are sent; a token under another policy is refused.

additions.name: tsa-policy-kept
additions.covers: A token under the policy asked for is the answer.

additions.name: tsa-sha384
additions.covers: A sha384 digest is asked for under sha384; a sha256 token for it is refused.

additions.name: tsa-other-digest
additions.covers: A token over another digest is refused.

additions.name: tsa-no-nonce
additions.covers: A token without the nonce sent does not answer this request.

additions.name: tsa-rejected
additions.covers: A rejection names its failure and status text.

additions.name: tsa-rejected-unnamed-failure
additions.covers: A failure bit with no name.

additions.name: tsa-granted-without-token
additions.covers: A grant without a token.

additions.name: tsa-unreadable
additions.covers: A reply that is no timestamp response, and a token that is no token.

additions.name: tsa-http-statuses
additions.covers: A 4xx is a refusal; a 5xx, a 429 or a failure is no answer.

additions.name: tsa-not-a-signer
additions.covers: A timestamp authority asked for a document signature.

additions.name: route-ocsp
additions.covers: httpRevocationSource: the route request for an OCSP question (D-2), and the answer passed on.

additions.name: route-crl-issuer
additions.covers: The route request for a CRL and for an issuer, with headers.

additions.name: route-refusals
additions.covers: A route that refuses, with and without its JSON; a 5xx, a 429 and a failure are no answer.

additions.name: token-verdicts
additions.covers: verifyTimestampToken: without trust, trusting the authority, over another digest, and unreadable.

additions.name: ecdsa-raw-from-der
additions.covers: ecdsaRawFromDer: DER to r || s, and the bytes it refuses.

additions.name: creation-awaiting-click
additions.covers: hasCreationAwaitingClick (a41ab182c): a polygon, a polyline and a callout wait for their next click once started; nothing waits before, nor after a cancel.

additions.name: ink-press-on-an-annotation-keeps-the-waiting-stroke
additions.covers: A pen drawing that waits for its next stroke is kept when a press lands on another annotation: the stroke becomes an annotation, and the press selects and drags the square it hit (d0601e65e). A tool picked during the next wait finishes that drawing too, and the picked tool stays active.

additions.name: shape-clicks-over-an-annotation
additions.covers: A shape made click by click owns its next click over an existing annotation (a41ab182c): a polygon takes a corner on the square, which is not selected, and no cursor or hover shows over it meanwhile; a first click on the square, with no shape waiting, still selects it.

additions.name: history-undo-and-redo
additions.covers: createHistoryCommands: history:undo (Mod+Z) and history:redo (Mod+Shift+Z, Mod+Y) follow canUndo and canRedo, and run undo and redo.

additions.name: history-labels-in-every-language
additions.covers: The i18n plugin's own strings: commands.history.undo and commands.history.redo (#1089) in its eight languages, as t() reads them and as the commands' labels.

additions.name: history-commands-without-the-plugin
additions.covers: createHistoryCommands: without historyPlugin() both stay disabled, and running one is refused.

additions.name: interaction-tool-commands
additions.covers: createInteractionCommands: tool:pointer, tool:pan and tool:zoom with their keys, tool:<id> for every other tool, active with the tool, visible when the document has it, enabled as canUseTool says.

additions.name: interaction-tool-commands-without-the-plugin
additions.covers: createInteractionCommands: without the interaction plugin a tool command is enabled but neither visible nor active, and the family names nothing.

additions.name: document-commands
additions.covers: createDocumentCommands: document:download (Mod+S) and document:print (Mod+P), disabled with no document, and refused where the document does not allow them.

additions.name: document-download
additions.covers: createDocumentCommands: document:download reads the file and hands it to the host as the document name ending in .pdf, of type application/pdf.

additions.name: selection-commands
additions.covers: createSelectionCommands: selection:copy (Mod+C) is disabled with nothing selected, and disabled without the selection plugin.

additions.name: snapshot-commands
additions.covers: createRenderCommands with a snapshot held: snapshot:copy hands the picture to the host in the press itself, snapshot:save waits for the picture, then names the file after the document and the page number (document p1.png, image/png), and snapshot:clear lets the snapshot go, which disables all three.

additions.name: annotation-delete
additions.covers: createAnnotationCommands with the annotation plugin: annotation:delete is disabled with nothing selected, enabled once an annotation the user may delete is selected, and deletes the selection.

additions.name: owners-absent
additions.covers: createStageCommands, createSelectionCommands, createAnnotationCommands and createRenderCommands without their plugins: every command disabled, tool:snapshot hidden but allowed, and the lists in order.

additions.name: update/create-in-the-session-group
additions.covers: A created field whose draft names no group takes the session group

additions.name: update/create-without-a-session
additions.covers: With no session a created field without a group has none

additions.name: update/create-names-its-group
additions.covers: A group the draft names wins over the session group

additions.name: update/copy-in-the-session-group
additions.covers: A copied field goes through the same create, with the session group

additions.name: update/undo-look-in-the-session-group
additions.covers: The undo look predicts with the session it is made for

additions.name: update/page-geom-of-no-size-shows-nowhere
additions.covers: A widget box with no width or no height shows nowhere: only the third widget is on the page (133030b8a)

additions.name: validation-info-needs-its-settings
additions.covers: canAddValidationInfo needs the revocation and trust settings and doc.sign; addValidationInfo without them rejects invalid-input, and without doc.sign permission-denied (32571b4b7).

additions.name: validation-info-requests
additions.covers: With revocation and trust, canAddValidationInfo is true; addValidationInfo of an unsigned or unknown field rejects not-found, a documentTimestamp without a timestampAuthority rejects invalid-input, and a refused engine door rejects as the engine said and re-judges at once (32571b4b7). canFill takes what signing takes (ceeb36bae).

additions.name: validation-info-added
additions.covers: addValidationInfo with trust and revocation over a timestamped signature whose answer the file already holds: nothing new is stored, for every signature and for one named field, and no document timestamp is asked for (32571b4b7).

additions.name: validation-info-and-a-failed-document-timestamp
additions.covers: With documentTimestamp: nothing new stored, but the signature has no document timestamp over it, so one is asked for, for a named field (the fqn branch of covered) and for every signature; the authority does not answer and addValidationInfo rejects with its failure (32571b4b7).

additions.name: validation-info-document-timestamp-needs-an-authority
additions.covers: The documentTimestamp setting without a timestampAuthority: addValidationInfo rejects invalid-input before anything is asked (32571b4b7).

additions.name: sign-then-validation-info
additions.covers: With the revocation setting, a seal is followed by its validation data; a failure there cannot undo the signature: sign resolves with validationInfo null and the failure in validationInfoError, and re-judges (32571b4b7, b08c0075d).

additions.name: sign-then-validation-info-and-a-failed-document-timestamp
additions.covers: With revocation, documentTimestamp and a timestamp authority that does not answer: the seal (no timestamp, per call) is followed by its validation data for the field it signed (the ref branch of covered), already complete, then the document timestamp fails. sign resolves with both validationInfo and validationInfoError (32571b4b7).

additions.name: prepare-with-a-timestamp-authority
additions.covers: A timestamp authority, the setting or the call's, makes prepareSignature reserve 16384 bytes for the token; a per-call null prepares without one. completeSignature refuses a CMS that is not SignedData before any authority is asked, and the signing stays prepared (3d167f772, b08c0075d).

additions.name: import-under-the-callers-id
additions.covers: importLibrary takes the id to import under over the one the file names (a97140dd0); an id already taken gets a fresh one, as an unnamed file does.
